# Zilog Z80

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from `crates/isa/src/z80.rs`. Edits here are overwritten; change the spec instead. -->

118 mnemonics, 704 encoded forms, operands little-endian. Generated from [`crates/isa/src/z80.rs`](https://github.com/asm198x/asm198x/blob/main/crates/isa/src/z80.rs).

8 of those forms are undocumented opcodes, marked **undocumented** below. They encode, because real programs use them.

Cycle counts show the base cost; `+p` is an extra cycle when an
indexed access crosses a page boundary, `+t` when a branch is taken.
